build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs && cd web/frontend && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "echo 'Starting bot_main.py'; python bot_main.py || echo 'bot_main.py failed'; echo 'Starting FastAPI'; python -m uvicorn web.backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --log-level info || echo 'FastAPI failed'; wait"
